title: Nailac's More Ores
description:
This project is a more ores mod!
I will try to make a good More Ores mod!
body:
This mod adds new ores to find and gives them a purpose. I am planning to make a lot more and keep it in this version. I am also planning to have create integration with a lot more!

# Changes
- Adds Bauxite and the charger, and Electrite.
  
  - Bauxite is a new ore that will be useful in a later update.
 
  - Electrite a eletric ore that is used to make the charger!

  - The charger is a block that is a battery.
